_comment: M4 work social events (Kimi C). Gate: active named assignment (M3 leaf). All options free; outcomes M3c-audited.

events.title: The Lunch Invitation
events.text: {person:coworker} has asked if I want to join the regular lunch crowd at the food court instead of eating at my desk.

choices.label: Join them
choices.outcome_text: I joined my coworkers at the food court and paid for my own lunch and several of their opinions about the boss.

choices.label: Eat at my desk
choices.outcome_text: I stayed at my desk for lunch and got ahead on work, which was productive and quietly lonely.

events.title: Cover For Me?
events.text: {person:coworker} needs someone to cover their shift on Friday for a family thing, and they are asking me with hope in their eyes.

choices.label: Cover the shift
choices.outcome_text: I covered my coworker's Friday shift for their family thing; my weekend shrank and my standing in the team grew.

choices.label: Sorry, I can't
choices.outcome_text: I told my coworker I could not cover their shift, and spent Friday feeling slightly guilty about my free evening.

events.title: The Rescue
events.text: {person:coworker} is drowning in their project and has asked, very quietly, if I know anything about the part that is beating them.

choices.label: Help them untangle it
choices.outcome_text: I spent an hour untangling my coworker's project mess with them, and we both left knowing more than we started.

choices.label: Point them to the manual
choices.outcome_text: I pointed my coworker at the manual and got back to my own desk; correct, ungenerous, and noted.

events.title: Office Gossip
events.text: A rumour about layoffs is going around, and {person:coworker} has cornered me by the printer to trade theories.

choices.label: Speculate together
choices.outcome_text: My coworker and I traded layoff theories by the printer until we had thoroughly scared ourselves for no confirmed reason.

choices.label: Refuse to gossip
choices.outcome_text: I refused to trade layoff gossip by the printer and got back to real work, calmer and slightly less popular.

events.title: The Desk Plant
events.text: {person:coworker} has gifted me a small cactus for my desk 'to liven the place up', and it is somehow already judging me.

choices.label: Name it and keep it
choices.outcome_text: I named the desk cactus something ridiculous and watered it on schedule; my coworker approves of my new colleague.

choices.label: Regift it politely
choices.outcome_text: I passed the desk cactus along to someone with a sunnier window, and my coworker pretended not to notice.

events.title: The Farewell Card
events.text: A popular colleague is leaving, and {person:coworker} is passing around a card that everyone is signing with actual feeling.

choices.label: Write something real
choices.outcome_text: I wrote something genuine in the farewell card, and the leaving colleague read it twice at their party.

choices.label: Just add my initials
choices.outcome_text: I added my initials to the farewell card and left the eloquence to everyone else at the party.
